title: refactor(console-ai)!: ADR-0057 final cleanup — remove chatDock flag + floating overlay + left Studio copilot
body:
The last step of ADR-0057 (epic #2409), after P3c #2467, go-live #2469, and follow-ups #2470. The docked chat is now the console's **one** chat presentation, unconditionally — the rollout flag and the code paths it guarded are gone.

## What

- **Flag removed**: `features.chatDock` is deleted from the runtime config. It had already flipped to default-on (#2469); the kill-switch retires together with the fallback it guarded.
- **Floating overlay retired**: `ConsoleFloatingChatbot` (the FAB-armed overlay, ~990 lines) and its `agentPicker` helper are deleted. `ConsoleChatbotFab` is now a small dependency-free launcher (`{ appLabel, onOpenDock }`) that opens the dock. On `/home` — which has no shell to host a rail — it opens the full-page `/ai` (the dock maximized).
- **Left Studio copilot removed**: the legacy `StudioAiCopilot` left panel is deleted; the copilot's one home is the right `StudioChatDock`. The ADR-0080 `aiSlot` injection seam (cloud edition) is **untouched**.
- **SDUI bubble unchanged**: the runtime `type: 'chatbot'` end-user bubble stays (ADR-0057 §4).
- **Mobile bugfix**: the chat bottom sheet no longer shows a "maximize" button. Navigating to full-page `/ai` from an **open** Radix sheet tore it down mid-close (the route change unmounts the console synchronously, so the scroll-lock/overlay never released) → the destination landed blank-and-frozen: *"tap maximize → the chat's just gone."* At 85svh the sheet is already the maximal mobile chat; `/ai` stays reachable via normal navigation, and its collapse-to-dock returns to the sheet.

## Verification

- `tsc --noEmit` clean across app-shell (the deletions leave no dangling imports); `apps/console` production build green.
- `npx vitest run` over layout / console / studio-design / runtime-config: **24 files, 113 tests green**. Updated: the runtime-config test drops the flag case; `ConsoleChatbotFab.test.tsx` reflects the launcher-only FAB; `ChatDock.test.tsx` asserts the mobile sheet has **no** maximize button.
- The dock behavior itself carries the browser proofs from #2467 / #2470 (rail ⇄ `/ai` same thread, Studio grid, mobile sheet, wide side-by-side, exact collapse landing).

Closes #2409 (ADR-0057 implemented in full; ADR Status flipped to **IMPLEMENTED IN FULL**).
